FEMA documented $79 million in damages, twice New York's threshold to qualify for federal disaster assistance. ($39.19 million in FY2026)

Following Trump's rejection of her appeal, Hochul said: "This storm met every FEMA threshold for federal assistance, yet the Trump Administration continues to play political games and betray every New Yorker who believes that the federal government is there to protect and support them. By refusing to intervene and grant our request, President Trump has told every New Yorker who weathered this major storm and the first responders, utility crews and emergency management staff who worked tirelessly to keep our communities safe that you do not matter to him.

But let's be clear, Republican members of Congress across New York are also enabling this neglect. Their continued silence and refusal to break with the President is a direct betrayal of the communities they were elected to serve. It is past time these members of congress demand that the President grant this disaster declaration and deliver every dollar of relief their constituents are owed."
